text.slice: Firmware Unpacking
Several file formats are supported: payload.bin, .img, .dat/.br and super.img.
Before unpacking any format, place the file in /storage/emulated/0/DNA/DNA_{project_name}/
After that, select the unpack menu item corresponding to your file format.
Unpacking payload.bin
When unpacking payload, two options are available:
• Automatically unpack extracted IMGs
All .img files extracted from payload.bin will be immediately unpacked further (without a separate repeated unpack run).
• Delete source file after completion
The original payload.bin will be automatically deleted after all unpacking operations are completed.
Unpacking .dat / .dat.br
This format is often used in non-dynamic systems (without a super partition).
Only one option is available — "Delete source file after completion": after unpacking, the original .dat and .dat.br files will be deleted.
Unpacking .img
Works almost the same as .dat/.br — one option "Delete source file after completion" is available (deletes the original .img after unpacking).
Supported partitions:
boot, system/vendor (and all their sub-versions — sys_ext, product, odm, etc.), userdata/metadata
Supported filesystem formats:
ext4, erofs, f2fs, kernel
Unpacking super.img
As with payload, two options are available:
• Automatically unpack extracted IMGs
All partitions extracted from super.img will be immediately unpacked further.
• Delete source file after completion
The original super.img will be deleted after all operations are completed.
Important Note
All .img files cannot be unpacked in sparse format — only raw is supported.
If you try to unpack a sparse image, the app will automatically convert it to raw and continue unpacking — there is no need to do this manually.
